_comment: Topic map for the edit. Times are in SECONDS OF THE SOURCE video.
build_plan.py snaps each 't' to the nearest speech gap within +/- SNAP
seconds, so the numbers below are intentions, not frame-exact cuts.
title  -> shown in the outro recap (keep <= 34 chars)
short  -> the one line in the side list (keep <= 16 chars)
Every title below was checked against the words actually spoken inside
its own window (work/speech.json). Do not name a topic from what the
lecture is 'about' in general -- name it from what is said there. An
earlier pass invented titles such as 'LLM и текст' and 'Роли и зарплаты'
for windows where neither an LLM nor a salary is ever mentioned.
title: Процесс обработки данных. Жизненный цикл данных. Понятие ETL-процесса
_topic_naming: the panel is a data-engineering table of contents, not a transcript.
a row is named for the CONCEPT being demonstrated, not for the incidental
example that demonstrated it: 'перегородки и доллары' is an illustration of
ETL, so the row is 'Аналогии, объясняющие ETL'; pictures and audio are
examples of unstructured data, so the row names the category.
the vocabulary is the field's, and industry terms stay in English: Data
Lake, ETL, Spark, Power BI -- never transliterated, never paraphrased.
the through-line is the data-engineering one: structured / semi-
structured / unstructured data, formats, Lake, then the pipeline stages
(extract, filter, clean, tokenize, scrape, aggregate), then stages,
abstract words (Аналогии, Диаграмма, Выводы) are allowed, but every row
carries an 'anchor': a word actually spoken inside its window.
scripts/audit_titles.py checks the anchor is really there -- that is what
keeps a general name from becoming a guess.
recap: true marks the topics the outro card lists.
